method: Three fresh baseline sessions taken from the earlier alternating exploratory run; three final candidate sessions afterward, with every shared package version pinned to baseline. Zero App-managed warm spares. Two streamed turns per session. Each environment starts from source and locked install; provider VM/cache state uncontrolled. Small samples, not latency percentiles. Compilation is paid inside dependency installation, not eliminated.
